items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. The clothing and jewellery are also excluded as personal property carried in a vehicle away from the insured location under §§4.3(d)–(f) and 4.5, so the payable amount is €0.
The private car is not insured property under §4.3(e), and §5.2.5 separately excludes vehicle-related expenditure. The payable amount is €0.
